# Frontend Development Instructions

Frontend Stack:
- React + Vite
- Tailwind CSS

UI Requirements:
- Clean dashboard UI
- Responsive layout
- Minimal modern design

Main Features:
- File upload UI
- Chat interface
- Retrieved context viewer
- Chat history
- Loading indicators
- Error handling

Component Rules:
- Use reusable components
- Keep components modular
- Separate API services from UI

Folder Structure:
src/
├── components/
├── pages/
├── services/
├── hooks/

API Integration:
- Use Axios
- Create centralized API service layer

Styling:
- Use Tailwind utility classes
- Avoid inline styles
